scope.name: pilot
scope.title: Pilot: Initialization, Recover, Shutdown and System Status (7251 SDS Workflow / SDS Event Handling)

2955303.text: If the SystemStatusRequest message is received over the is/iw/rx topic before the initialization starts, appSMM software responds with the SystemStatusResponse having the current status: "NotInitialized".

2532404.text: If SMM initialization does not start within 20 seconds after the InitializationRequest message is received, appSMM software publishes the InitializationResponse message with Status "Error" over the is/iw/tx topic.

2528710.text: The InitializationRequest and InitializationResponse messages are logged in appSMM log files. The message topic and content of each exchanged message is included in the log files.

2528703.text: If system clearing is completed (all racks detected during initialization were moved to Output), appSMM software publishes a SystemStatusNotification message which notifies that the CurrentState of the system changed to "Idle".

2528698.text: After publishing the InitializationResponse message with Status "OK", appSMM software sends a SystemStatusNotification message over the is/iw/tx topic, which notifies that system state changed from "NotInitialized" to "Initializing".

2525423.text:
SMM begins the initialization process only after the InitializationRequest message is received over the is/iw/rx topic and the system state is "NotInitialized".

Note:

When the InitializationRequest message is received over the is/iw/rx topic, appSMM transmits the 'InitializeCmd' command to rtc_appl, only when the system state is 'NotInitialized'.

2752658.text: After restart appSMM software publishes the SystemStatusNotification message over the is/iw/tx topic, to notify the Bridge that the current system state is "NotInitialized".

2653086.text: If the SMM system goes to E-Stop following a fatal error, appSMM software publishes a SystemStatusNotification message which notifies that system status changed from "Idle" (PreviousState) to "E-Stop" (CurrentState).

2551270.text: If the SetConfigurationResponse message was published over the is/iw/tx topic, appSMM software automatically publishes the SystemStatusNotification message over the is/iw/tx topic, which notifies that system state changed from "Configuring" to "NotInitialized".

2535547.text:
If a loaded rack was picked up by the Distributor either from Input lane or from FrontIn while the system status is "Idle", appSMM software publishes a SystemStatusNotification message over the is/iw/tx topic with the following details:
- "PreviousState":"Idle"
- "CurrentState":"NormalOperation"

2528708.text: The SystemStatusRequest, SystemStatusResponse and SystemStatusNotification messages are logged in appSMM log files. The message topic and content of each exchanged message is included in the log files.

2528706.text: If all SMM lanes are successfully initialized, appSMM software publishes two SystemStatusNotification messages, which notifiy that the CurrentState of the system changed firstly to "Idle" and then to "Clearing".

2525392.text: After it gets connected to the MQTT Broker, the appSMM software automatically publishes a SystemStatusResponse message each time when a SystemStatusRequest message is received over the is/iw/rx topic. The SystemStatusResponse message is always published over the is/iw/tx topic.

2525390.text:
The structure of the SystemStatusNotification message published by appSMM software matches the structure of the message file attached under Properties.
The SystemStatusNotification message is always published over the is/iw/tx topic.

2525388.text: Following appSMM connection to MQTT Broker, the appSMM software publishes two SystemStatusNotification messages over the is/iw/tx topic, to notify that CurrentState of the system changed first to "PowerOn", and then to "NotInitialized".

2427781.text: If the SetConfigurationRequest message is received over the is/iw/rx topic and the system state is 'NotInitialized', appSMM software automatically publishes the SystemStatusNotification message over the is/iw/tx topic, which notifies that system state changed from "NotInitialized" to "Configuring".

2653094.text:
If the system is shut down following a fatal error event, the SMM system can be re-started if the RecoverRequest message is received over the is/iw/rx topic.

After the RecoverRequest message is received over the is/iw/rx topic, the SMM system follows the recovery procedure, as described in 2532492, 2532504, 2532508, 2532510.

2532492.text: If the RecoverRequest message is received over the is/iw/rx topic, appSMM software sends the "DeInitializeCmd" command to RTC, in order to initiate system de-initialization. The "DeInitializeCmd" command is sent only if the system status is "E-Stop".

2532504.text: If rtc_appl replies with 'DeInitializeRsp' within 20 seconds, appSMM software publishes the RecoverResponse message with Status "OK" over the is/iw/tx topic. The structure of the RecoverResponse message published by appSMM software matches the structure of the message file attached under Properties.

2532508.text:
If rtc_appl does not reply with "DeInitializeRsp" during 20 seconds (see 2532504), appSMM software publishes the RecoverResponse message with Status "Error" over the is/iw/tx topic.

Note:

The timeout for receiving the rtc_appl reply for any command ("CommandResponseTimeoutMilliseconds") is configured in the appSMM.yaml file, which can be viewed/updated in appSMM folder.

2532510.text: After publishing the RecoverResponse message, appSMM software sends the 'InitializeCmd' command to RTC, in order to initiate system initialization.

2428419.text: After sending the ShutdownResponse, appSMM software publishes a SystemStatusNotification message which notifies that system status changed from "Idle" (PreviousState) to "E-Stop" (CurrentState)

2428417.text: If rtc_appl replies with "StopRsp" within 20 seconds, appSMM software publishes the ShutDownResponse with Status "OK", over the is/iw/tx topic. The structure of the ShutDownResponse message published by appSMM software matches the structure of the message file attached under Properties.

2854281.text:
If the connection to SMMBridge is re-established and appSMM software restarts following the RecoverRequest message (see 2653094), appSMM software publishes an event over the is/iw/tx topic, with the following details:

- "Category": "Operator"
- "EventId": ??
- "Severity": "Warning"
- "TimeStamp": time when the event was detected
- "Message": "The SMM system went to E-Stop because the connection to SMMBridge was lost. Connection is re-established now."
- "EventArgs": none

2854109.text: If the SMMBridge gets disconnected, the SMM system goes to default E-Stop state (i.e. system follows the behaviour described under Default E-Stop chapter).

2327588.text:
The SMM:
- Responsible for association of sample ID to tube position and rack.
- Moves racks efficiently through the system.
- Dynamically routes racks through the system as FIFO, while respecting constraints provided per rack via the Bridge for priorities and destinations.
- Actively requests the route for each rack in the system, at each destination decision checkpoint and state change (based on the current SMM and track state, rack location and/or bridge's reroute notification).
The Bridge:
- The single point of interface for all SMM to analyzer and IW communications.
- Upon request from the SMM, calculates the next destination analyzer for the rack. The algorithm to determine the route is Werfen’s responsibility and is independent of the track logic. The route (next analyzer) is calculated based on the analyzers' capabilities, analyzer's current schedule, analyzer's material expiration, configuration options on the IW and test orders coming from the IW.
- Upon request from the SMM, calculates the next analyzer for the rack. The algorithm to determine the route is Werfen’s responsibility and is independent of the track logic. Currently the route (next analyzer) is calculated based on a multitude of considerations e.g. analyzers' capabilities, analyzers' current schedule, analyzers' material expiration, configuration options, resource utilization and sample test orders.
- Assigns the priority and destination analyzer specific for each requested rack.
The IW:
- Assigns test orders to the samples (via LIS or manual entry).
- Cancels test orders.
- Recalls a sample.
- Manages jobs for each test order.
- Creates Rerun/Reflex jobs when necessary.
- Handles the completion and release for each sample.
- Initiates system operating commands and settings, e.g. change of states, configuration, shutdown, etc.
- Collects and responds to system monitoring and error management information.
- Is a system module external to the SMM, and therefore not in the scope of this requirement document.
2327588.notTestableReason: PDS overview statement: no observable behaviour at the ICD

1640380.text: The Sample Tube Identification Software shall perform a controlled shutdown of the software and OS when requested over the external interface.

1853224.text: The system shall operate in the following states:

1853226.text:
State	Purpose	
Powerd On	Operator powers up the device.
The operating system starts up and launches the instrument control software.	
NotInitializedReady to initialize or configure	
InitializingInstrument mechanics and electronics are initialized, brought to home position and prepared for proper usage.
ConfiguringConfiguration changes of the system can be made within this state.
E-Stopped (Halted)After a fatal error the device stops.
Instrument can be initialized as a recovery action.	
Idle (Ready)Device is ready to be used. 
Clearing (Maintenance)Device is performing additional tasks after initializing to put the system into a defined state (e.g. removal of racks).
Normal Operation (Active, AllJobsRunning)Device enters this state once the first rack is loaded and processed.
ShutdownDevice is shutting down.

1853239.text: The user shall be able to request SMM system initialization from the IL software.

1853241.text: The user shall be able to identify that the system was successfully initialized.

1853245.text: The SMM system shall complete initialization when all SMM modules could be successfully initialized and all racks, excepting the ones occupied in the pipettor lanes of offline analyzers (see Requirement 2394906), have been moved to the Output lane.

1932308.text: If a Fatal Error is generated the system shall suspend all SMM running rack processing jobs.

1932310.text: If a Fatal Error is generated a user interaction is required for recovery (see 2389460).

1932312.text: After a fatal error and possible user recovery an initialization must be performed.

1932314.text: After a Fatal Error the system shall abort any pending rack processing job during initialization.

1932397.text: The system execution shall stop after reporting a Fatal event and the system status goes to E-Stop (Halted).

1939068.text:
SMM shall automatically restart after an unexpected software failure.
SMM shall inform IW about the fact that the SW was not shut down properly.
Afterwards the instrument will be in status "Powered On" / NotInitialized and Initialization is required to continue normal operation.

1939072.text:
SMM shall publish the following changes in system information and configuration so that it can be shown and appropriate action can be taken if needed: 
- SMM system status changes
- system connections changes (e.g. when an analyzer is disconnected)
- I/O module status changes
- occupying status of Input/Output lanes and FrontIn/FrontOut ports
- track status changes
- location changes for a given rack within the SMM system (when the rack is moved)

2384071.text:
The system shall operate in the following states: 
- Powered On: Booting OS and SW
- Not Initialized: Ready to initialize or configure
- Initializing: Homing all modules & self test
- Configuring: Ready to update configuration
- E-Stopped: Error state - all motors stoped
- Idle: Ready to accept racks
- Clearing: Perform maintenance tasks - e.g. remove racks
- Normal Operation: Process racks - Identify - Dispatch - Notify progress

2384136.text:
appSMM shall publish system status Clearing when racks are moved to the output.
In case of success appSMM shall publish system status Idle after clearing finished.
In case of error appSMM shall publish system status E-Stop.

2384146.text:
appSMM shall initiate recovery from fatal error codition (E-Stopped) when requested.
After recovery the state will be not initialized (2387196).

2384148.text: appSMM shall automatically publish system status (2384071) changes as they occur.

2384154.text: appSMM shall initiate an immediate shutdown of the software and OS when requested.

2386628.text: appSMM shall publish system status (2384071) when requested.

2387196.text:
appSMM shall initiate system initialization when requested.
(Only possible when state is not initialized)

2389460.text: The user shall be able to initiate error recovery from the IL software, after fatal error scenario (see 1932312 and 1932314 for more details).

1783271.description:
As a user I want SMM to go into E-Stop (1710297) in case of an error situation that cannot be automatically recovered.
Recoverable scenarios need to be explicitly defined by user stories/requirements. Otherwise default error handling will apply.
 
Related:
ASD-User Story 1722622: System Recovery

2403408.description:
Definition:
*. As a system user I need to know if the initialization of the SMM system was successfully initiated during the StartUp sequence, so that I can manage the system.
 
Acceptance Criteria:
*. The appSMM software shall process the InitializationRequest message when received.
*. The appSMM shall automatically respond with InitializationResponse message when requested, regardless if:
	*. there are analyzers connected or not
	*. there are available pippetors or not.
*. The InitializationResponse message shall include:
	*. OK - if the SMM Initialization can start
	*. Error - if the SMM Initialization cannot start (e.g. when a hardware error prevents initialization of the system)
*. The InitializationResponse message content and structure shall correspond to the expected schema, which can be found at:
	*. https://git.stratec.com:8443/projects/P7251/repos/beacon_icd/browse/schemas
*. The message shall include the 'version' property as mandatory property, by referencing the current JSON schema version (see request 2272789)
*. 

Notes for testing were added in the Notes section. Diagram showing the sequence of exchanged messages is attached under the Notes section.
 
Out of Scope:
*. The initialization process of teh SMM system will be handled in a different user story. The current user story handles only the InitializationResponse message.

2404051.description:
Definition:
*. As a system user I need to know the status of the SMM system during the Start-Up, so that I can manage the system.
 
Acceptance Criteria:
*. The appSMM software shall process the SystemStatusRequest message when received.
*. The appSMM shall automatically respond with SystemStatusResponse message when requested.
*. The SystemStatusResponse message shall report one of the following statuses, depending on the state of the system on that moment:
	*. "PowerOn"
	*. "NotInitialized"
	*. "Initializating"
	*. "Idle"
	*. "NormalOperation"
	*. "E-Stop"
	*. "Configuring"
	*. "Clearing"
*. The SystemStatusResponse message content and structure shall correspond to the expected schema, which can be found at:
	*. https://git.stratec.com:8443/projects/P7251/repos/beacon_icd/browse/schemas
*. The message shall include the 'version' property as mandatory property, by referencing the current JSON schema version (see request 2272789)
*. 
Note:
Only one of the system states mentioned above is send by the appSMM in the SystemStatusResponse during the Start-Up sequence; afterwards, any system change will be send in the SystemStatusNotification message.
Diagram showing the sequence of exchanged messages is attached under the Notes section.
 
Out of Scope:
*. The use case when the analyzer sends SystemStatusNotification each time when changes occur in the system status is handled under a different user story (ASD-User Story 2404069). The current user story is related only to the Start-Up sequence.

2404069.description:
Definition:
*. As a system user I need to be notified about changes in SMM system status during the Start-Up sequence, so that I can manage the system.
 
Acceptance Criteria:
*. The appSMM software shall notify the Bridge when its system status changes during the Start-Up sequence.
*. The appSMM shall automatically publish a SystemStatusNotification message when its status changes (see the diagram attached under the Notes section).
*. The SystemStatusNotification message shall report both the previouse and current system status.
*. The following statuses shall be considered to be reported in the SystemStatusNotification message during start up and initialization:
	*. "PowerOn"
	*. "NotInitialized"
	*. "Initializating"
	*. "Idle"
	*. "E-Stop"
	*. "Clearing"
*. The SystemStatusNotification message content and structure shall correspond to the expected schema, which can be found at:
	*. https://git.stratec.com:8443/projects/P7251/repos/beacon_icd/browse/schemas
*. The message shall include the 'version' property as mandatory property, by referencing the current JSON schema version (see request 2272789)
*. 

Diagram showing the sequence of exchanged messages is attached under the Notes section.
 
Out of Scope:
*. The use case when the analyzer sends SystemStatusResponse when requested is handled under a different user story (ASD-User Story 2404051).
*. The use case when the appSMM sends a SystemStatusNotification while the system is in normal operation mode will be handled under a different user story. The current user story is related to the Start-Up sequence (i.e. reporting statuses as PowerOn, NotInitialized, Initializing).
*. System state "Configuring"

2404361.description:
Definition:
*. As a SMM system user, I want to be able to initiate shut down the appSMM software, so that all SMM system components are safely stopped.
 
Acceptance Criteria:
*. The appSMM software shall automatically initiate the shut down when requested.
*. The appSMM system shall process the ShutDownRequest message when received.
*. The appSMM software shall respond with ShutDownResponse message.
*. The ShutDownResponnse message shall correspond to the expected schema, which can be found at:
	*. https://git.stratec.com:8443/projects/P7251/repos/beacon_icd/browse/schemas/IcdGetversionResponse_schema.json
*. The ShutDownResponse message shall include:
	*. OK - if the SMM system can initiate the shut down
	*. Error - if the SMM shut down cannot start (e.g. when a hardware error prevents shut down of the system)
*. The message shall include the 'version' property as mandatory property, by referencing the current JSON schema version (see request 2272789)
*. 
*. When the shut down procedure is innitiated, the appSMM shall do the followings:
1. de-initialize
2. close all connections
3. shut down

Diagram showing the sequence of exchanged messages is attached under the Notes section.

Out of Scope:
*. Scenario when the appSMM system goes to E-stop (Halted) state due to a fatal error will be handled in a separate user story.
*. There is no use case for Error response code - cannot be tested.

2419846.description:
Definition:
*. As a SMM system user, I want to be able to recover the appSMM system after E-stop, so that the system starts safely after a fatal error.
 
Acceptance Criteria:
*. The appSMM software shall automatically initiate the system recovery from E-Stopped state when requested.
*. The appSMM system shall process the IcdRecoverRequest message when received.
*. The appSMM software shall respond with IcdRecoverResponse message.
*. The IcdRecoverResponse message shall correspond to the expected schema, which can be found at:
	*. https://git.stratec.com:8443/projects/P7251/repos/beacon_icd/browse/schemas/IcdGetversionResponse_schema.json
*. The IcdRecoverResponse message shall include:
	*. OK - if the SMM system can initiate the system recovery (State is E-Stopped)
	*. Error - if the SMM system recovery cannot start (State is not E-Stopped)
*. The message shall include the 'version' property as mandatory property, by referencing the current JSON schema version (see request 2272789)
*. When the system recovery procedure is initiated, the appSMM shall automatically start without the need to apply power off/power on
*. After successful start, the system shall switch to state Not initialized

 Out of Scope:
*. N/A

2488626.summary: New routing: SystemStatusNotification during normal operation mode (appSMM)
2488626.description:
Definition:
*. As a system user I need to be notified about changes in SMM system status during operation mode, so that I can manage the system.
 
Acceptance Criteria:
*. The appSMM software shall automatically publish a SystemStatusNotification message each time when its system status changes during normal operation mode.
*. The following statuses shall be considered for the current user story, to be reported in the SystemStatusNotification message:
	*. "Idle" - after successful initialization and clearing, when the system is ready to accept racks
	*. "NormalOperation" - while the system is processing racks
	*. "E-Stop" - when the system goes to E-stop (Halted) state due to a fatal error
*. The SystemStatusNotification message content and structure shall correspond to the expected schema, which can be found at:
	*. https://git.stratec.com:8443/projects/P7251/repos/beacon_icd/browse/schemas
*. 

Diagram showing the sequence of exchanged messages is attached under the Notes section.
 
Out of Scope:
*. The use case when the appSMM sends a SystemStatusNotification during Start-Up, configuration changes or clearing are handled under different user stories. The current user story is related only to reporting the above mentioned statuses.
*.

2492146.description:
Definition:
*. As a system user, I need to be able to change the appSMM configuration settings.
 
Acceptance Criteria:
*. The appSMM software shall process the SetConfigurationRequest message when received.	
*. The appSMM software shall accept and persist the configuration changes, only if the SetConfigurationRequest message is received when the system state is NotInitialized.
*. The appSMM software shall ignore the changes requested in the SetConfigurationRequest message if received when system state is other than NotInitialized (in such case we respond with 'Fail' for all configuration settings included in the message).
*. The SMM software shall automatically reply with SetConfigurationResponse when the SetConfigurationRequest is received.	
*. The SetConfigurationResponse message shall report success (Ok - when the system state is NotInitialized) or failure (Fail - for any system state other than NotInitialized) of updating the following configuration settings:

	*. Tube identification failure strategy	
	*. barcode symbology configuration	
	*. hematocrit mode configuration	
*. When the SetConfigurationRequest is received, appSMM software shall automatically publish a SystemStatusNotification message to notify that the CurrentState of the system changed to 'Configuring'.	
*. After the SetConfigurationResponse is published, the system status will change back to 'NotInitialized'	
*. The SetConfigurationResponse message content and structure shall correspond to the expected schema, which can be found at: https://git.stratec.com:8443/projects/P7251/repos/beacon_icd/browse/schemas	
*. The message shall include the 'version' property as mandatory property, by referencing the current JSON schema version (see request 2272789).	
*. appSMM shall update the configuration on the Camera STI software when changes are requested by Werfen on barcode symbologies or Hct.	
*.  In case the Camera STI cannot apply the requested configuration(s) (e.g. Camera STI is offline), appSMM replies with 'Fail' for those specific configuration(s) only	
*. The appSMM software shall persist the last configuration settings upon restart	
*. The default configuration values shall be (according to meeting minutes from 28.Oct.2021 Werfen weekly software meeting, attached to notes, called "2021-10-28 Meeting notes - SW weekly.pdf"):

	*. Tube identification failure strategy: process known samples	
	*. Barcode symbology enabled:

		*. Code128	
		*. Code128Checksum	
	*. Hct configuration: enabled

2741405.description:
Definition:
*. As a user I need that the system automatically recovers after an unexpected software failure
 
Acceptance Criteria:
*. appSMM shall detect when the system was not shut down gracefully, but because of an unexpected software error.
Hint: This can be done by storing a running flag in the config file, which is set to OFF when the system is shut down gracefully. If the software is shut down unexpectadly, this flag is still ON upon restart
The flag will be set to ON each time when the system starts.
*. When the software shuts down following an unexpected software failure the SMM system shall automatically restart afterwards
*. After the the appSMM software restarts following an unexpected software failure, appSMM shall detect that the system was not shut down properly and shall publish a Warning event to notify the Bridge that SW was not shut down properly:
*. 
	*. Category: Operator
	*. EventId: F00008
	*. Severity: Warning
	*. Timestamp: the time when the event was detected
	*. Message: "Software was restarted after unexpected error. Initialization is required"
	*. EventArgs: none
*. The system will require initialization.
*. 
 
Out of Scope:
*. N/A

2837620.description:
Definition:
*. As a user I need SMM to go to E-Stop when connection to the Bridge is lost.
 
Acceptance Criteria:
*. When the connection to the Bridge is lost, the SMM system shall go to E-Stop
*. SMM shall try to re-establish the connection to the Bridge, for indefinite time.
*. After the connection is re-established, in order to restart the system after going to E-Stop, the user has to trigger system recovery (i.e. trigger the RecoverRequest message) - handled under u.s. 2419846
*. When the connection to the Bridge was re-established, appSMM shall publish a Warning:
Category: Operator
EventId: as specified in the Event list
Severity: Warning
Timestamp: the time when the event was detected
Message: "The SMM system went to E-Stop because the connection to SMMBridge was lost. Connection is re-established now."
EventArgs: none
*. 
  
Out of Scope:
*. System recovery is handled under u.s. 2419846

2430841.summary: [Instrument ]Test Case 1 - Verify that the InitializationRequest message is triggered only when the appSMM status is NotInitialized
preconditions: Make sure you installed the needed version of appSMM on the RTC Board and Integrated Simulator.
steps: 1. Start the instrument
2. Open PUTTY ,login to RTC using the root/3edcft6 credentials and run docker stop <name_of_appsmm_container> , to stop appSMM container
3. Open WINSCP and delete all files from the /home/root/dockerLogs folder
4. Within PUTTY run the following command docker start <name_of_appsmm_container>, to start the appSMM container
5. Open Integrated Simulator and click on the power button in the Bridge tab
6. Open WINSCP and navigate to /home/root/dockerLogs folder
7. Open the Bridge log check that there are 2 messages : SystemStatusRequest and SystemStatusResponse
8. Open appSMM log using Smart Inspect and Bridge log from the Integrated Simulator - Bridge tab.
9. Wait for the status of SMM to change to Idle and check again the appSMM and Bridge logs.
expected: 7. In the Bridge log there should be 2 messages displayed corresponding to SystemStatusRequest and SystemStatusResponse actions and the SystemStatusResponse message should display 'NotInitialized'
8. In both appSMM and Bridge logs there should be 2 messages of type: InitializationRequest and InitializationResponse , displayed after the SystemStatusResponse one.
9. No InitializationRequest and InitializationResponse should be displayed after the status is changed to Idle.

2806610.summary: [Instrument]Test Case 1:Verfiy that if the system shuts down unexpectedly appSMM automatically restarts and publishes a FatalError
steps: 1. Start the instrument.

EventId: as specified in the Event list

The system should require re-initialization.

2855849.summary: [Simulator][TC1] Verify that when SMMBridge is disconneted the SMM system goes to E-Stop

appsmm: 0.7.2303.13001-il_develop
il_smm-simulator-win-x64_0.7.2303.13.01
preconditions: Make sure you installed the needed version of appSMM, Integrated Simulator.
steps: 1. Start mqtt, appsmm and simRTC applications.
2. Start the Integrated Simulator and initialize the system.

expected: 4. The system should go to E-Stop.

Category: Operator
EventId: as specified in the Event list
Severity: Warning
Timestamp: the time when the event was detected

EventArgs: none
When the connection has been re-established the user should be able to trigger the system recovery.
